verdict.rationale: Chronicle Labs has a documented API reference with pages on authentication, reliability and telemetry, plus SDK method-to-endpoint tables such as events.search mapping to POST /v1/search. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, such as a try-it console or live request playground. Probes of the usual OpenAPI spec paths all returned 404, so a static reference is only adjacent to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
